newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank approves money changer licences.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank approves money changer licences.

text.p: Bangladesh's central bank said it had offered money changer licences to 55 private firms and companies, including 39 approved on Thursday.
This was intended to ease trading in major currencies, a Bangladesh Bank (central bank) official said on Thursday.
"This arrangement will ease the sufferings of the general people seeking to convert currencies," he said. "Now they don't need to stand in queues at bank counters to transact foreign currencies."
Presently, one person is allowed to buy up to $500 from a changer but there is no limit to change the foreign currency into local unit, the taka, the official said.
